bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the Chanhassen Bluffs Sports Complex; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CHANHASSEN; CHANHASSEN BLUFFS SPORTS COMPLEX.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

(a) $22,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Chanhassen to design, construct, furnish, and equip a regional recreation, community, and event center, to include two sheets of indoor ice, a walking track, indoor turf, indoor playground, gathering space, meeting rooms, and other amenities. This appropriation includes money for the acquisition of real property or interests in real property.

(b) The city must implement a fee schedule for free or reduced rates of admission to and use of the facility funded under this section for residents of the city of Chanhassen.

(c) The facility funded under this section must be designed to include rainwater recapture and solar energy infrastructure, in conformance with or in addition to any design requirements for the facility necessary to comply with the sustainable building guidelines under Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.325.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $22,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) $22,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Chanhassen to design, construct, furnish, and equip a regional recreation, community, and event center, to include two sheets of indoor ice, a walking track, indoor turf, indoor playground, gathering space, meeting rooms, and other amenities. This appropriation includes money for the acquisition of real property or interests in real property.
(b) The city must implement a fee schedule for free or reduced rates of admission to and use of the facility funded under this section for residents of the city of Chanhassen.

(c) The facility funded under this section must be designed to include rainwater recapture and solar energy infrastructure, in conformance with or in addition to any design requirements for the facility necessary to comply with the sustainable building guidelines under Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.325.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $22,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
